templates.html:
<fieldset class="fs" style="--accent:{{accent}};"{{#if disabled}} disabled{{/if}}>
  <legend class="fs__legend">{{legendText}}</legend>
  <label class="fs__opt"><input type="{{inputType}}" name="speed" checked> Standard (3–5 days)</label>
  <label class="fs__opt"><input type="{{inputType}}" name="speed"> Express (next day)</label>
</fieldset>
<style>
.fs { width: 300px; box-sizing: border-box; font: 15px/1.5 system-ui, sans-serif; color: #241430; background: #FAF7F2; border: 1.5px solid #24143025; border-radius: 10px; padding: 16px 20px 18px; }
.fs:disabled, .fs[disabled] { opacity: .5; }
.fs__legend { padding: 0 6px; font-weight: 700; font-size: 13px; text-transform: uppercase; letter-spacing: .04em; color: var(--accent); }
.fs__opt { display: flex; align-items: center; gap: 8px; padding: 6px 0; font-size: 14px; }
.fs__opt input { accent-color: var(--accent); width: 16px; height: 16px; }
</style>
templates.tailwind:
<fieldset{{#if disabled}} disabled{{/if}} class="w-[300px] box-border font-sans text-[15px] text-[#241430] bg-[#FAF7F2] border-[1.5px] border-[#24143025] rounded-[10px] px-5 pt-4 pb-[18px] disabled:opacity-50">
  <legend class="px-1.5 font-bold text-[13px] uppercase tracking-wide" style="color:{{accent}}">{{legendText}}</legend>
  <label class="flex items-center gap-2 py-1.5 text-sm"><input type="{{inputType}}" name="speed" class="w-4 h-4" style="accent-color:{{accent}}" checked> Standard (3–5 days)</label>
  <label class="flex items-center gap-2 py-1.5 text-sm"><input type="{{inputType}}" name="speed" class="w-4 h-4" style="accent-color:{{accent}}"> Express (next day)</label>
</fieldset>
